TITLE:
How many folds would it take
to reach the Moon?
NEXT:
Which of the three
did you try?

EN.몇 번 접으면 달까지 닿을까요?: How many folds to reach the Moon?
EN.14번이면 어른 키만큼: 14 folds: as tall as a grown-up
EN.정답은 A! 42번이면\n달까지(약 38만km) 도착:
The answer is A! 42 folds
reach the Moon (about 384,000 km)
EN.하지만 진짜 종이는\n7~8번쯤에서 더 안 접혀요:
But real paper usually stops folding
at about 7 or 8 times
EN.직접 접어 보세요!\n몇 번까지 됐는지 댓글로!:
Try it yourself!
Tell us how many folds you got!
